featured_reviews.name: MOHAMMED IBRAHIM GIRNI
featured_reviews.review_text:
✨ EPIC & HISTORIC TRIBUTE ✨
Celebrating 100 Years of Maganlal Dresswala – Juhu Scheme, Near Kala Niketan

Established in 1926, Maganlal Dresswala has stood tall for a century, surviving and thriving across three generations. From the pioneering days when they became the first to rent costumes to the entire cast of the first-ever Bollywood movie, to today’s vibrant cultural celebrations, their journey is nothing short of legendary.

At the helm of this legacy is the dynamic and charming Ms. Sarika Punjabi, whose agility, resilience, and professionalism have kept this family business alive and flourishing. Her patience and passion shine through in every detail – even in managing the moods, mischief, and tantrums of children with grace and warmth.

🌸 My First Visit – A Republic Day Surprise 🌸

On 26th January 2026, during our Republic Day celebrations, the children of our society staged a surprise dance performance to the timeless song:
“Madhuban mein jo Kanhaiya kisi gopi se mile…”

Clad in the traditional costumes provided by Maganlal Dresswala, the children transformed the atmosphere into one of pomp, gaiety, and glittering festivity.

- Their white turbans, kurta& Dhoti pyjamas, vests, and red waistbands radiated purity and tradition along with colorful and shimmering ghagra choli for little girls.

- The colorful balloons and festive backdrop amplified the joy of the occasion.

- The children’s innocent smiles and graceful dance moves brought alive the moods of devotion, celebration, and unity.

It was a spectacle where heritage met modern festivity, and the costumes became the bridge between tradition and performance.

🌟 Legacy That Inspires 🌟

Maganlal Dresswala is not just a costume house – it is a living institution of Indian cinema and culture. For 100 years, they have:

- Preserved the art of costume-making.

- Empowered generations of performers.

- Brought authenticity, elegance, and grandeur to countless stages and screens.

Their centenary year is a reminder that tradition, when nurtured with resilience and innovation, becomes timeless.

🙏 Our Heartfelt Wishes 🙏

On behalf of our society and the children who danced with joy in their costumes, we extend our warmest wishes to Maganlal Dresswala:

➡️ May your journey continue to inspire.
➡️ May your legacy shine brighter with each passing year.
➡️ May your artistry keep weaving magic into India’s cultural fabric.

Here’s to another century of costumes, culture, and celebration! 🎉

featured_reviews.name: Shweta Nag
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Date The Ramp, and I feel compelled to share it so other brides don’t go through the stress I faced on my wedding day.
I had booked my wedding lehenga in 23 August 2025, a beautiful pink outfit that I instantly loved. At the time of booking, I was charged ₹10,000, and the team assured me that all damages (missing diamonds, loose threads, etc.) would be fixed before my wedding on 5th December.
However, when I went to pick up my dress one day before the wedding, I was shocked.
Most of the diamonds were missing on both the blouse and the lehenga
Threads were loose and hanging
The fitting was uncomfortably tight
The outfit looked worn out and completely unprepared
I had already purchased all my jewellery and accessories to match this dress, so changing the outfit last minute wasn’t possible. The manager told me the previous staff had left and promised they would fix the diamonds and make it “perfect.” I even compromised and requested them to fix at least the front area, especially where the yellow diamond moulds looked empty.
They assured me everything would be done.
But on my wedding day, when I opened the dress around 3 PM, the diamonds were still missing, and the outfit looked shabby and unfinished. I cannot express how stressful and heartbreaking it was to face this just hours before my wedding. They completely ruined the look of my wedding outfit while still charging a premium amount.
Overall, this was an extremely unprofessional and upsetting experience. I would not recommend Date The Ramp to anyone, especially brides who are trusting them with important occasions.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The delivery took a while due to some technical reasons but the store manager made sure it reaches store at the promised date for my trial.

I really appreciate he going above and beyond to get the delivery at the decided date as it was getting difficult for me to delay this any further

Couple of other good things I would like to highlight for this rental shop-
1. There is no deposit, we just have to pay the rental amount while other such stores take almost double the rental amount as deposit
2. They are flexible in providing the attire 2 days prior to the 4 day event window and were also providing porter feature from their end for delivery. These things are not at all entertained by other such stores
3. They allowed taking pictures, videos and also if u wish to video call anyone. Other stores are very rude and just don not allow any of this.

I had a very pleasant experience and would
100% recommend  this store if u r planning for any rental pieces.
